name: Taj Mahal
description: UNESCO World Heritage white marble mausoleum built by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan.
scamWarning: Unauthorized guides outside western gate; refuse unmetered auto quotes over ₹150 from cantt station.
culturalEtiquette: Strict shoe-covers required on marble platform; no tripods, large bags, or food allowed inside.

name: Amber Fort & Palace
description: Majestic hilltop fort featuring red sandstone, marble pavilions, and Sheesh Mahal mirror work.
scamWarning: Aggressive gemstone and textile hawkers; stick to RTDC approved shops.
culturalEtiquette: Modest clothing recommended; stay on marked paths during steep climb.

name: Hawa Mahal
description: Five-story honeycomb pink sandstone palace with 953 windows designed for royal women to observe street festivals.
scamWarning: Rooftop cafes claiming exclusive views charge high mandatory order fees; check menu prices first.
culturalEtiquette: Narrow stairways; watch your step and respect local photography rules.

name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple & Ghats
description: One of the 12 sacred Jyotirlingas, located along the holy Ganges River with evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat.
scamWarning: Brahman 'VIP Darshan' touts claiming instant entry; fake cremation wood donation requests at Manikarnika.
culturalEtiquette: Leave footwear, phones, and leather items at authorized temple lockers. Dress modestly. Never photograph funeral pyres.

name: Qutub Minar
description: The 73-meter fluted red sandstone minaret built in 1193, surrounded by ancient ruins including the 4th-century rust-resistant Iron Pillar.
scamWarning: Touts offering illegal entry skips or fake parking fees outside.
culturalEtiquette: Keep grounds litter-free; do not climb on historical stone carvings.
